gayatri-jayanti: TITHI CONFLICT (decision needed). Sources give three answers: (a) Jyeshtha Shukla Ekadashi, the day after Ganga Dussehra (Drik Panchang; Hitavada 2020 says Gayatri appeared on Nirjala Ekadashi); (b) Jyeshtha Shukla Dashami (hindu-blog; Ganga Dussehra day); (c) Shravana Purnima (Drik Panchang lists it as a 'Matantara', Boldsky 2026 gives 28 Aug 2026 on Shravana Purnima, and the site's Sivananda-basis). The Gayatri Pariwar (AWGP) pairs Gayatri Jayanti with Ganga Dussehra (Dashami) and marks Acharya Shriram Sharma's mahasamadhi (2 June 1990) on it; its page names no tithi. Mainstream June observance is the majority view; Shravana Purnima is the minority view. Recommend changing whenText/calendarBasis to June (Jyeshtha Shukla Ekadashi, with the Pariwar keeping Ganga Dussehra) and noting the Shravana Purnima/Avani Avittam view as an alternative. The draft history, Haridwar and South India entries were written to be neutral.
South India Avani Avittam entries apply only if the site keeps the Shravana Purnima reckoning; Drik says the Shravana Purnima view usually coincides with upakarma.
